candidates.change_summary: Removed the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can change owner, altering owner after setOwner calls from non-admins.
Changed setOwner to set owner to tx.origin instead of the provided parameter, making owner differ after call.
Made setOwner set owner to address(0) regardless of input, so owner differs after setOwner.
Inverted the authorization check in onlyAdmin so only non-admins may call setOwner, changing who can change owner and thus observed owner after calls.
Change the function to return false instead of true after setting owner.

Modify onlyAdmin modifier to bypass the admin check, allowing setOwner to run for any caller which may change observed return behavior when caller differs (keeps original return true in setOwner but allows different callers to invoke).
Removed the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can change owner (allows non-admin callers to update owner).
Replaced assignment to owner with assignment to admin so setOwner changes admin instead of owner (observable: owner remains unchanged after call).
Changed onlyAdmin require condition to check msg.sender == owner instead of admin, allowing owner (not admin) to call setOwner and thereby changing who can update owner.
Negated the onlyAdmin require condition so callers other than admin can call setOwner (inverts access control).
